name: Private screening decoys
description: Decoy orbits for private conjunction screening and the experiment that measures how well they hide a real orbit. decoys generates decoy histories from a population of real ones (independent draws, rotated copies, resampled or chained histories, or copies of the target itself). features computes rotation-invariant features of each history from its element sets (gp view) or from daily FFM (Full Force Model) ephemeris windows (ffm view), including the distance to the nearest public object. distinguish trains a gradient-boosted tree classifier, cross-validated by target, and reports AUC, a 95 % lower bound on epsilon, and the probability that the real history scores highest of N. Typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only. Histories are $LFV rows (id, target, role, generator, class) carrying their $OMM element sets; FFM windows are one $OEM; feature rows and the distinguishing report are $LFV. Settings are node CONFIG through plugin.getConfig (SDS $PIV, one ModuleConfig), one table per method: decoys {generator, window, perTarget, targets, donors, neighbours, seed}, features {view, window, minPoints}, distinguish {folds, depth, rounds, learningRate, lambda, minChildHessian, bins, seed, ranks, exclude, relative}.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 evaluation, seeded draws and statistics over caller-supplied histories. One plugin.getConfig hostcall (the settings); no threads or network access.

inputPorts.description: The real histories decoys are drawn from (the public catalog), one $LFV row each (SOURCE_ID the id, optional TARGET and CLASS_LABEL) with its $OMM element sets (EPOCH, MEAN_MOTION, ECCENTRICITY, INCLINATION, RA_OF_ASC_NODE, ARG_OF_PERICENTER, MEAN_ANOMALY, BSTAR); each is also a target.

outputPorts.description: Decoy histories as $LFV rows: ROLE Decoy, TARGET the real history each one hides, GENERATOR, and the $OMM element sets. SOURCE_COUNT the targets asked, REFERENCE_COUNT the donors (population histories with 6 element sets in the window), SKIPPED_COUNT the decoys refused for fewer than 6 sets.

inputPorts.description: Real and decoy histories as $LFV rows (SOURCE_ID, TARGET, ROLE, GENERATOR, CLASS_LABEL) with their $OMM element sets (gp view); the real ones are the catalog.

ffm view: daily ephemeris windows, one $OEM block per window: OBJECT.OBJECT_ID the history (SOURCE_ID), START_TIME the window start, the lines up to USEABLE_STOP_TIME the samples over one orbit (GCRF km, km/s), and the line at STOP_TIME after USEABLE_STOP_TIME the state at the next window start.

outputPorts.description: One $LFV row per history with enough points: VALUES in FEATURE_NAMES order (NaN = not computable), VIEW gp or ffm, SOURCE_COUNT the histories, REFERENCE_COUNT the catalog, SKIPPED_COUNT those with too few points.

inputPorts.description: Feature rows from features ($LFV): the real rows and one generator's decoy rows; ROLE Real counts as real, any other role as decoy.

outputPorts.description: The distinguishing report: $LFV REPORT (AUC, balanced accuracy, the held-out threshold test with its 95 % epsilon lower bound, P(real first of N) and N_eff overall and by class, per-feature separation and gain share, and with many decoys per target the real row's rank within its own group).
